prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, black glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other — wearing a skin-tight glossy white latex catsuit with long sleeves and matching latex gloves, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the latex fully covering her bust, stretched over every curve from neck to ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbows and knees, completely opaque, the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, and a seamless white latex hood covering her whole head, face and neck with mirror shine, closed by a zipper at the back, with three openings cut in the latex: two almond-shaped openings around her eyes, a small opening for her nose and one around her lips. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a thick straight round bar of aged brass with a green verdigris patina that spans the full width of the chamber from one stone wall to the other, both ends set deep into the stone blocks, at a height just above her raised hands, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her wrists a little wider apart than her shoulders and her arms raised straight up. Her left ankle wears heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, its ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb that runs up to the brass bar above her, pulling that leg up and forward with the knee bent, the chain pulled dead taut, and from that ring also hangs a short chain ending in a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball dangling below her lifted foot. Her right ankle wears heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, its ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb down to a huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor beside her standing foot. Pose: standing on her right leg, facing the camera, her left leg lifted forward and up with the knee bent by the chain, her arms raised straight up to the bar with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her head tipped slightly forward, her bare standing foot flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Wear: A grey film of dust and soot dulls the shine across her hips and thighs, sweat runs in clean tracks down the polish of her arms, and dark smudges mark the gloves at her fingertips. Faint soot smudges circle the openings around her eyes, her lips are dry and a little cracked, and her bare feet are caked with soot and grime.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy white latex with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is wrapped in the glossy latex hood, only her eyes, nose and lips showing through their openings — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a hint of quiet misery, her brows tilted up slightly at the inner ends and her lips pressed together, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the chamber around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.

poses: standing full height, facing the camera, one hand relaxed at her side, the other lifted away from her body, her feet shoulder-width apart, her legs fully in view, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view
